reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: Charles Wood: public domain needs a death year before 1955, work in print before 1850 ("activeBy"), or "traditional": true for an anonymous source; the score has a bar of another length (bar 7), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 001249 (the melody read from 001249a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 1 note off in 16); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Erfurt has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1663, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). Melchior Franck has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; the tune was in print by 1663, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001249a.nwc).
